intro: Egypt earns money from the Suez Canal, tourism, gas and workers abroad.

chapters.title: Suez and tourism
text: About an eighth of world trade normally passes through the Suez Canal, earning Egypt billions. Tourism to the pyramids, Luxor and the Red Sea is a major employer.

chapters.title: Challenges
text: Egypt imports much of its wheat. High inflation and debt have made life hard, and Red Sea shipping attacks since 2023 cut canal income.
